title: NEVER START YOUR DAY UNTILL YOU SAY THIS POWERFUL PRAYER
text: Glory to Jesus Christ. Hallelujah. Someone is receiving their mantle today. Before this service ends, there will be a shifting. The spirit of God is here with intent, with purpose, with divine appointment. I want you to know that the Lord has looked upon you this morning with the eyes of a father who says, "I see what you are going through. I see the weight. I see the struggle. I see the warfare. And I am here to reposition you." If this word reaches you today and you know that God is speaking, please share this message. Do not keep it to yourself. Someone under the sound of my voice needs this more than you know. Your obedience to share could be the gateway through which the Almighty shifts the trajectory of someone's entire existence. The glory of God is released through ordinary vessels who dare to say, "I will carry this fire to the next person." Lift your hands wherever you are. lift them high. Open your mouth and bless the Lord. Father, we honor you. Jesus, we acknowledge you. Holy Spirit, we yield to you. There are moments when heaven interrupts time. This is one of those moments I sense a strange stillness, yet there is fire in the atmosphere. Someone is about to win before the day even starts. Pray in your understanding for a few seconds. Just thank him. Thank him because you are alive. Thank him because you are preserved. Thank him because mercy spoke louder than accusation. Now lift your voice and say, "Lord, I'm here. Speak to me. Change me. Use me." Please share this broadcast wherever you are watching from. Someone's destiny is hanging on what God is about to release. You may be the bridge God uses to rescue a life. Now let's worship Jesus. Jesus. Jesus. We worship you not because things are perfect. We worship you because you are faithful. You are the alpha. You are the omega. You are the one who goes before us. Breathe on us again. Holy Spirit. Breathe on us again. There is no distance in the realm of the spirit. Whether you are in Africa, Europe, Asia, the Americas, the same fire is touching you now. Lift your voice. Father, we bless you. We adore you. We magnify you. You are the God who keeps watch over the morning. You are the God who commands the sun. You are the God who wakes men up for destiny. Thank you for light. Thank you for revelation. Thank you for victory that does not wait for battle. Somebody say, "I love you, Lord." Now listen, there is a burden in my spirit this morning. The Lord said to me, many believers are praying, but they are praying too late. They are reacting instead of legislating. They are responding instead of commanding. The title the spirit gave us is not motivational. It is strategic. Beat the enemy to your day. Pray this before 7:00 a.m. Hear me carefully. There are days that are neutral, but there are also days that are already programmed. Scripture says in Job 38 12, "Have you commanded the morning since your days began and cause the dawn to know its place?" That means mornings can be commanded. That means days can be instructed. That means time can be aligned. Psalm 5:3 says, "My voice you shall hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning I will direct it to you and I will look up." David understood something. If God hears you first, the enemy loses access. Many attacks succeed not because they are powerful, but because they arrive before prayer. Listen, every day is a gate. Every morning is an altar and whoever speaks first often controls the atmosphere. Lamentations 3:es 22:23 says, "It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed. They are new every morning. Mercy is released in the morning, but mercy must be engaged." Psalm 57:8 says, "Awake my glory. I will awaken the dawn." Not the dawn awakening David. David awakening the dawn. Hear me. If you don't wake up your destiny, life will wake up your battles. If you don't speak to the day, the day will speak to you. This is why Jesus rose early. Mark 1 35. Now in the morning, having reason a long while before daylight, he went out and prayed. The son of God would not start a day without alignment. Who are we to think we can survive casually? Now as I'm speaking I'm seeing someone named Michael. You have been fighting patterns repeated resistance. Every morning the Lord says today that cycle breaks. I'm seeing a woman named Grace. There is unusual heaviness when you wake up. The spirit of the Lord says that cloud lifts. Now someone named Daniel. There has been a delay hanging over your mornings. By the authority of Jesus, it expires today. Now listen carefully. Before 7:00 a.m. is not magic. It is authority. It is timing in the spirit. There is a shift that happens as the day opens. And those who are spiritually sensitive take advantage of it. Ecclesiastes 10 1617 speaks of a land whose prince is it in the morning for drunkenness and another whose prince is it for strength. Timing determines outcomes. Now we are about to pray. But before we pray, I need you to understand this. You are not begging today. You are legislating. You are not pleading today. You are enforcing. Luke 10 19. Behold, I give you authority and nothing shall by any means hurt you. Authority works when it is exercised early. So wherever you are, sit up, stand if you can. This is warfare. Lift your right hand. Say this slowly with fire. In the name of Jesus, I take authority over this day. I speak before the enemy speaks. I decree before darkness moves. I claim this morning for God. Now open your mouth and pray in the spirit zarushka. Fire is rising. I decree and declare every agenda planted overnight against your destiny by dreams, by altars, by covenants, they are dismantled. Now Psalm 91 56 says, "You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day." That means arrows can fly in the day, but they don't have permission to land. I stand by apostolic authority and I declare no arrow will locate you today. Every satanic meeting held concerning you before sunrise scatter now. Every voice programmed to speak failure be silenced. I see someone named Rebecca. There was a word spoken against your finances yesterday. The Lord says it will not stand. Now pray. Command your day. Father we decree alignment. We decree favor. We decree open doors. Isaiah 45:es 2:3 says, "I will go before you and make the crooked places straight." So I prophesy what was crooked today become straight. What was blocked opens what was delayed accelerates. Now begin to declare today I walk in light. Today I walk in favor. Today I walk under open heavens. I break every covenant speaking against my family. I disconnect from inherited battles by the blood of Jesus. I erase evil handwriting. Galatians 3. Christ has redeemed us from the curse. So I declare no cause has permission to follow you into this day. I see a man named Samuel. There has been chest discomfort and fear in the mornings. The Lord heals you now. Peace enters your body. Lay your hand on your head. Say, "My mind is sound. My body is strong. My spirit is aligned." Now pray again in the spirit. Shakabarushka zerehat. Angels are being released. Psalm 103 20 says, "Angels excel in strength, hearkening to the voice of God." So I decree as you speak today, angels move. I release angelic preservation over your movements. No accident, no mishap, no evil report. Listen, there are people who wake up tired, not because they slept late, but because they fought battles all night without knowing. Job 57 says, "Man is born unto trouble as the sparks fly upward. But hear me, not every trouble is permitted to follow you into the day." This is why we are praying before the day hardens. Now I want you to hear this carefully. There are spirits assigned to time wasting. Spirits assigned to early discouragement. Spirits that make sure before 9 a.m. you already feel defeated. But today by the spirit of the Lord we intercept them. Psalm 118 24 says this is the day the Lord has made we will rejoice and be glad in it. Not the devil's day not your enemy's day the Lord's day. Lift your voice and say this day belongs to God. My destiny is not negotiable. Now begin to pray aggressively. Mantohat, I decree in the name of Jesus, every evil altar speaking into your mornings, altars of frustration, delay, bad news, sudden loss, they catch fire now. Isaiah 54 17 says, "No weapon formed against you shall prosper." Weapons can be formed overnight, but they don't get permission to prosper. I stand in apostolic authority and declare every weapon prepared against your health today fail now someone named Esther there has been fear around medical reports the Lord says your body responds to healing now lay your hand on your body say I receive life I receive strength I receive restoration now listen there are families under siege marriages attacked in the morning Humans before breakfast, cold silence before the day starts. But hear the word of the Lord. Psalm 127:1 says, "Except the Lord build the house, they labor in vain. Today God rebuilds homes." Lift your voice and pray for your family. Father, I decree peace in my home. I silence voices of division. I release love and understanding. I see a man named Joseph. There has been strain in your marriage. The Lord says humility and healing are released now. Now pray again in the spirit. Zeroshata calabandoske rattata bhata financial gates are opening. Listen carefully. Deuteronomy 8 18 says it is he who gives you power to get wealth. Power can be activated early. Some people lose money before noon because they didn't guard the gate of the day. But today I decree no financial leakage. Lift your right hand and declare. I command my finances to align. I reject loss. I walk into favor. I see a woman named blessing. Money has been sleeping through your hands. The Lord says wisdom enters today. Proverbs 10 22 says the blessing of the Lord makes rich and adds no sorrow. So I decree no sorrow attached to your provision. Now listen there are covenants spoken unspoken inherited that activate early morning resistance but Galatians 3 13 still stands. So by the blood of Jesus we break covenants with failure. We break covenants with stagnation. We break covenants with rising and falling. Say it boldly. I am free. I am delivered. I move forward. Now pray again. Shakabarto. Angels are moving. I see angelic traffic around someone named Emmanuel. There has been danger around transportation. The Lord preserves you today. Psalm 121 8 says, "The Lord shall preserve your going out and your coming in." So I decree you will return safely. You will not be a victim. Now hear this. There are people whose virtues were drained through wrong relationships, through emotional exhaustion, through spiritual attacks in dreams. But today is a day of restoration. Joel 2 25 says, "I will restore the years the locust has eaten." Lift your hands and receive. Father, restore strength. Restore joy. Restore focus. I speak to your mind. Be clear. I speak to your spirit. Be alert. I see someone named Michael again. There is confusion around decisions. The Lord gives you clarity today. Hear this carefully. There are demonic systems that operate on timing. They wait for moments of silence. They wait for moments when men are careless. But today we arrive before them. Ecclesiastes 3:1 says to everything there is a season and a time for every purpose under heaven. I announce by the authority of Jesus your time has come. Now lift your right hand and decree with fire in the name of Jesus. I step ahead of darkness today. I arrive before trouble. I outrun evil. I decree my days aligned with destiny. My steps are ordered by God. Psalm 37 23 says the steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord. So I declare no wrong step, no costly mistake, no error today. Now pray aggressively in the spirit. Rakataboshhata zaketba mtoka I speak prophetically now. Every witchcraft activity programmed into your day through mirrors, through incantations, through midnight rituals, they collapse now. Micah 52 says, "I will cut off witchcraft out of your hand. So I decree witchcraft loses grip. Manipulation loses power. Monitoring spirits go blind. I see someone named Abigail. There has been monitoring over your progress. The Lord says the watchers are confused now. Now decree again. I am invisible to evil eyes. I am covered by the blood. Zechariah 2:5 says, I will be a wall of fire around her. So I release a wall of fire around you. Your children, your work, your name. Now listen, there are people whose time has been stolen, delayed beginnings, slow mornings, energy drained before productivity. But hear the word of the Lord. Ephesians 5 16 says, "Redeeming the time because the days are evil." So lift your voice and decree, "I recover lost time. I recover lost speed. I recover lost momentum. I see a young man named David. You've been struggling with consistency. The Lord restores discipline and focus now. Now pray again. Destiny helpers have been activated. Isaiah 60 1 says, "Arise, shine, for your light has come. So I decree, help us locate you early. Favor meets you before noon. Good news finds you today. I see someone named Ruth. There is a conversation scheduled later today. The Lord says it turns in your favor. Now decree boldly. Today doors open. Today resistance bows. Today I win. I speak to your health by the authority of Luke 8 43-48. Every lingering affliction dries up now. Pain disappears. Strength returns. Peace floods your body. Lay your hand where you need healing and say, "I receive healing now. My body aligns with life." Now hear this final decree in this wave. Every siege around your destiny. Siege of delay, siege of frustration, siege of rising and falling, it is over. Nahome 1 9 says affliction shall not rise up the second time. So I decree this battle ends permanently. Lift your hands and pray in the spirit one more time. Mantohat zelera. Listen carefully. There are moments when heaven says enough. Enough delay. Enough resistance. Enough cycles. This is one of those moments. The spirit of the Lord is saying the siege is over. 2 Samuel 5 20 says, "The Lord has broken through my enemies before me like a breakthrough of water. When water breaks through, it does not negotiate, it overwhelms." So I decree whatever has stood in your way collapses suddenly. Lift your voice and say it boldly. The siege is over. I move forward freely. Now pray in the spirit. Deep, slow, strong. I am seeing chains breaking, chains around mornings, chains around motivation, chains around joy. Psalm 30 5 says, "Weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning." I prophesy this morning carries joy. This day carries laughter. This week carries testimony. Someone named Paul. There has been emotional heaviness for weeks. The Lord lifts it now. I speak to your soul. Breathe again. Hope again. Now listen. There are people who survived the night but were not meant to drag the night into the day. So I decree every residue of yesterday's pain be wiped away now. Isaiah 43 1819 says, "Remember not the former things. Behold, I do a new thing. So I announce today is new. This week is new. This season is new. Lift your right hand and receive this. I decree favor before men. I decree favor before systems. I decree favor before authorities. Psalm 52 says, "For you, oh Lord, will bless the righteous. With favor you surround him as with a shield. So I release favor as a shield over you. No rejection today. No humiliation today, no shame today. I see a woman named Hannah. There has been silent tears and private prayers. The Lord says, "Your season turns now." Now pray again in the spirit. Shakataba Zorohats are on assignment. Hebrews 1 14 says, "They are ministering spirits sent to serve the heirs of salvation. So I decree angels escort you today. Angels protect your steps. Angels fight unseen battles. You will not walk alone. I speak to your work. I speak to your business. I speak to your studies. Excellence rises. Clarity rises. Results manifest. I decree divine preservation. Psalm 91 11 says, "He shall give his angels charge over you to keep you in all your ways." So I declare no accident, no sudden bad news, no evil interruption. Now lift your voice and shout this decree wherever you are. I win today. I overcome today. I testify today. Yes. Now I seal this ministration by the authority of Jesus Christ. I seal your morning. I seal your afternoon. I seal your night. I decree this week is your testimony. I decree speed replaces delay. I decree strength replaces weakness. Walk into favor. Walk into peace. Walk into answered prayers. The siege is over. Your destiny is preserved. Your helpers are released. Lift your hands one last time and pray in the spirit. Raabashhat mantohata zeleterba hear me some victories are announced others must be guarded that is why we decree again the spirit of the lord is saying don't just win early remain ahead 41 10 says fear not for I am with you I will uphold you with my righteous right hand so I decree now you will not lose momentum today you will not drop focus. You will not sabotage your own victory. Lift your right hand and say it clearly. I remain ahead today. I finish strong. I end the day in peace. Now pray briefly in the spirit. I decree over your mind no confusion, no anxiety, no mental fog. Philippians 2 5 says, "Let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus." So I release the mind of Christ over you, clarity, discipline, wisdom. I see someone named Andrew. There has been pressure around decision making. The Lord gives you precision today. Now decree, I choose correctly today. I hear God clearly. I walk wisely. I decree over your mouth. No careless words, no emotional reactions, no statements that open doors to regret. Psalm 141 3 says, "Set a watch, O Lord, before my mouth. So I declare your words preserve you today. I decree over your relationships, no unnecessary arguments, no provocation, no misunderstandings." Romans 12 18 says, "As much as lies within you, live peaceibly with all men." So I release grace to respond gently and firmly. I see a woman named Messi, there has been tension with a colleague. The Lord gives you favor and wisdom today. Now listen, some attacks don't come as trouble, they come as distraction. So I decree every assignment of distraction today cancelled. You will focus. You will complete tasks. You will finish what you start. Ecclesiastes 9 10 says, "Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with all your might." So I prophesy excellence and productivity. Now decree boldly, I am productive today. I am efficient today. I am fruitful today. I speak to your steps again. Psalm 119 105 says your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path. So I decree no detours, no wasted movements, no wrong alignments. I see a man named Isaac. You were about to cancel an appointment. The Lord says go. It will bless you. Now lift your hands. This is the final declaration. By the authority of Jesus Christ, I decree that today will not end in regret. I decree that today will not end in sorrow. I decree that today will not end in emptiness. Instead, it will end in gratitude. It will end in peace. It will end in testimony. Listen carefully. There are victories God gives you and there are victories God entrusts to you. This one is an entrustment. Psalm 124 6 says, "Blessed be the Lord who has not given us as prey to their teeth." Meaning, you escaped what was meant to swallow you. So I decree what did not catch you in the night will not catch you in the day. What missed you in the morning will not find you later. Lift your right hand and say, "I am not prey. I am preserved." Now hear this. Some of you were waking up with a sense of impending trouble. a strange expectation that something might go wrong. That expectation breaks now. Job 3 25 says, "The thing which I greatly feared has come upon me, but today we reverse it." Proverbs 10 24 says, "The desire of the righteous shall be granted." So I decree, what you expect today is favor. What you expect today is peace. What you expect today is help. Expectation is realigned now. I speak prophetically. Every invisible line the enemy drew around your progress, you step over it now. Every invisible ceiling, it shatters now. Zechariah 4:7 says, "Who are you, oh great mountain? Before Zerubbabel, you shall become a plane. So I decree, mountains flatten, resistance dissolves, complexity simplifies." Now listen, some of you are carrying silent fatigue, not physical, spiritual exhaustion from fighting too long. But Isaiah 40 31 says, "They that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength." So I release renewal now. Strength to your spirit, strength to your emotions, strength to your body. Lay your hand on your chest and say, "I receive strength. I am renewed. I see someone named Joshua." You've been carrying responsibility heavier than your age. The Lord says, "Help is released today." Now, let me decree over your entire day. Hour by hour, I decree that your morning remains calm. I decree that your afternoon remains productive. I decree that your evening ends in satisfaction. Psalm 90:14 says, "Oh, satisfy us early with your mercy. So, I decree you will not chase fulfillment today. fulfillment will meet you. I speak to your name. Any negative association attached to your name be cleared. Proverbs 22:es 1 says, "A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches. So I decree honor, respect, and credibility. I speak to your destiny. Every agenda of postponement cancelled." Habacook 2:3 says, "At the appointed time it shall speak and it shall not lie." So I decree your appointed time is active. Your season is open. Your door is unlocked. Now lift both hands. This is the final prophetic seal by the authority of Jesus Christ. I seal your mind against confusion. I seal your heart against fear. I seal your body against sickness. I seal your steps against error. I seal your destiny against sabotage. No replay of old battles. No return of former struggles. No recycling of pain. Nah 1 9 again. Affliction shall not rise a second time. So I decree this ends here. This ends permanently. Now pray softly in the spirit. Slow, victorious. Raabasha manto bashhata zelba. Yes, it is finished. It is sealed. It is enforced. Go walk into favor. Walk into alignment. Walk into testimony. You beat the enemy to your day. You stayed ahead. You finished well. Amen.
